metadata.title: On the Origins of "Hostless'' Supernovae: Testing the Faint-end Galaxy Luminosity Function and Supernova Progenitors with Events in Dwarf Galaxies

notes: No eligible stars. The materials discuss extragalactic “hostless” supernovae and unnamed statistical populations of hypervelocity stars, but do not identify any individual star as a present-day Galactic unbound candidate or follow up an individually identified prior candidate (see T:p2-b1 and T:p7-b2).
